item.title: Tennis: India Secures Hosting Rights For Billie Jean King Cup Asia/Oceania Group I
item.description: Billie Jean King Cup Asia: In a significant achievement, India has again been awarded the hosting rights for the 2026 Billie Jean King Cup (BJKC) Asia/Oceania Group I event, which will be held at the DLTA Stadium in New Delhi from April 7 to 11.

item.title: T20 WC: Chakaravarthy's Accuracy Makes Him A Challenging Bowler, Says Mhambrey
item.description: T20 World Cup: India wrist-spinner Varun Chakaravarthy's relentless accuracy, pace and subtle variations are the factors which make him a very challenging bowler for batters to face, feels former India bowling coach Paras Mhambrey.

item.title: India To Send 50 Athletes For Dubai 2026 Para Athletics GP, Season-opening Fazza Int’l Championships
item.description: World Para Athletics Grand Prix: India will bring 50 Para-athletes, which includes Paris 2024 Paralympic stars and newcomers in their line-up, while hosts UAE will field the biggest contingent of 65 athletes in the Dubai 2026 World Para Athletics Grand Prix to be held at the Dubai Club for People of Determination grounds next week.

item.title: T20 WC: India's All-round Depth And Pace Attack In Prime Shape, Says Mhambrey
item.description: T20 World Cup: India's all-round options and the complementary fast-bowling partnership of Jasprit Bumrah and Arshdeep Singh have the team well-positioned ahead of their Men’s T20 World Cup title defence, said former bowling coach Paras Mhambrey.

item.title: BATC 2026: Indian Women To Face China, Men Take On Korea In The Quarterfinals (Ld)
item.description: Badminton Asia Team Championships: Defending champion India will take on China in the women's quarterfinals, while the men will face South Korea in the last eight stage of the Badminton Asia Team Championships (BATC) 2026 in Qingdao, China on Thursday.

item.title: Aussie Pacer Josh Hazlewood Ruled Out Of T20 WC
item.description: T20 World Cup: Australia suffered another injury blow as fast bowler Josh Hazlewood has been officially ruled out of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, starting on Saturday in Sri Lanka and India, after failing to recover in time for the showpiece event.

item.title: Mumbai Open WTA 125K: Doubles Top Seed Rutuja Bhosale Ousted, China’s Fangran Tian Causes An Upset On Day 4
item.description: Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association: Hosts India suffered a setback as two of its top doubles hopes crashed out even as Fangran Tian of China registered an upset, knocking out Hanne Vandewinkel, the fourth seed of the tournament, in an eventful Day four of the 2026 Mumbai Open WTA 125K Series, which witnessed edge of the seat action in the singles and doubles clashes at the Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association (MSLTA) on Thursday.

item.title: T20 WC: Batting Firepower, All-round Resources, Spinners Hold The Key In India’s Title Defence (SWOT Analysis)
item.description: T20 World Cup: India begin their Men’s T20 World Cup title defence on Saturday through a Group A clash against the USA at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai. With unmatched batting depth, enviable all-round resources and spinners in their prime, India has everything in their arsenal to become the first nation to win consecutive T20 World Cups and claim the trophy on home soil.

item.title: Atletico Madrid Thrash Betis To Reach Copa Del Rey Semifinal
item.description: Atletico Madrid: Atletico Madrid delivered a convincing performance to claim the semifinal spot in Spain's Copa del Rey with a 5-0 rout of Real Betis.

item.title: T20 WC: Very Happy With India’s Progress, Hopes Are Really Very High To Retain The Title, Says Mhambrey
item.description: T20 World Cup: Having lifted the Men’s T20 World Cup trophy for the first time in 2007, before breaking a long drought to clinch the crown in 2024, defending champions India are aiming to become the first team to achieve three milestones: retain the crown, win it three times, and clinch a World Cup in the shortest format on home soil.
